title: Password Spraying (Active Directory)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for SUMMIT.LAB (Summit Retail Group, a retail chain), no Windows VMs. Account lockout is disabled and a roster of store-staff domain users is seeded; every password is policy-compliant, but exactly one account (k.verma, a store manager) still uses the weak onboarding default while the rest are strong and random. Spray a short list of common candidate passwords across the roster, find the single account that authenticates, and use it to read the flag from a share only that account may open.
question: Spray a list of common candidate passwords across the domain user roster, recover the single account that reuses the onboarding default password, and use it to read the flag from the //dc/storeops share.
